title: W-1: the v0.1.0 binary fails codesign verification; sign on macOS and gate the release on it
description: Source: the consolidated pre-public security review (opum-doc, 2026-10-30), reviewed at b1dae53374a8c0c3514f015ff77faac9af643e2d; tracked under ODOC-552 and parent WCLI-95. Report id: W-1 (critical). The published ward-darwin-arm64 fails codesign --verify --strict (exit 1, invalid signature: code or signature have been modified) and spctl, while its sha256 matches the published manifest; the install runbook only displays the signature, so a user following it concludes the artifact is good. The installed binary is the same file and fails the same way. Publisher identity ruled A (W-36): stay ad-hoc, sign on macOS, verify in the release gate, with build provenance (W-15 task); a Developer ID is a later spend question for the operator. A rebuild is a new cdhash and needs one keychain re-approval. Release-path change: needs Opus review.

acceptanceCriteria.text: The released ward-darwin-arm64 is built and signed on macOS and passes codesign --verify --strict
codesign --verify --strict is a release gate in .github/workflows/release.yml, so an artifact that fails it cannot be published
The install runbook verifies the signature (and fails the step) rather than only displaying it
test/release-workflow.test.ts asserts verification, not only a displayed cdhash
The asset is rebuilt, republished and re-verified, and the keychain re-approval after the new cdhash is handed to the operator as steps

implementationNotes: opum-doc ruling, 2026-10-30T16:29:41Z (to be recorded on ODOC-552), third bullet verbatim: "Plan the operator's single sitting to cover everything that forces a re-approval: these snapshot changes and the W-1 rebuild, whose new cdhash needs the keychain approved again (WCLI-96). Batch them into one release and one sitting, not three." Context (WCLI-98 ruling): WCLI-98 folds into WCLI-84's profileSnapshotVersion, and no release is cut until WCLI-98 has landed on dev alongside #208.

AC2-AC4 landed as ward-cli#224, squash 014498101c2de2c4a1e76dc59eaa0a39ff681dbb, per DEC-253. AC2: .github/workflows/release.yml has a verify job (macos-14, tag-only, downloads the artifact the release would publish, runs codesign --verify --strict --verbose=2 out/ward-darwin-arm64) and release needs [build, verify]. AC3: install runbook step 3 runs the strict verify, must exit 0, stops on any other exit before the CDHash comparison. AC4: test/release-workflow.test.ts asserts the verify job, the hosted macos-14 runner, release needs verify, and the runbook text; mutating needs, --strict and runs-on each turned exactly its predicted test red. Opus review (unit ward-cli-review-96, claude-opus-5-5, model read from its transcript by team-lead): VERDICT: APPROVE at 28233ec, BLOCKING: none (as relayed by team-lead; the review message itself is not on this worker). CI Check, Docs and Tracker integrity green on 28233ec. NOT DONE, left unticked: AC1 (macOS build and sign of the released binary) and AC5 (rebuild, republish, re-verify, operator keychain re-approval steps), both batched to the operator release sitting. The verify job has not run yet; its first run is the release tag, and an org Actions spending limit refusing macOS minutes would fail it closed. Follow-up PR for the reviewer non-blocking items 1, 3, 4, 5, 6 is next; NB2 (verify on workflow_dispatch) goes to opum-doc.

Reviewer verdict, as relayed by team-lead (a relay, not the unit full message), from ward-cli-review-96 (claude-opus-5-5, model read from its transcript): "VERDICT: APPROVE at 28233ec / BLOCKING: none". Follow-up PR folds NB1, NB3-NB6 and NB2 as ruled A in DEC-253 (a1): verify also runs on workflow_dispatch, release stays push-of-a-tag only. Owed, not done: the reject-path dry run on the Linux-built artifact (record its run id) and the accept-path dry run at the operator sitting, both billed macos-14 runs that wait on dec-14tajwo being answered A; no dispatch run has been triggered.

Confirmatory review of the follow-up, landed as ward-cli#226 squash ae69da39f2e79acdd5b846745368fbeeba6e9a51 (head 4c10b3e, checks green). Verdict from ward-cli-review-96b (claude-opus-5-5, model read from its transcript): "VERDICT: APPROVE at 4c10b3e / BLOCKING: none". Its non-blocking items, condensed by team-lead, so this is a relay and not the unit message. NB1: a step-level if: on the codesign step, or a re-sign step before it, still passes every test; fix by pinning verify steps to exactly [download-artifact, codesign] with one if: and one run:. NB2: the release no-status-function test should assert exactly one if: line. NB3: the build-has-no-event-if test catches one spelling only; assert no job-level if: on build. NB4: runbook step 3 dropped "do not run the file", and the Rollback steps-2-3 rule cannot be met for a pre-release build. NB5: "until republished" needs rewording, since the workflow cannot republish v0.1.0; say "install the release that supersedes it". NB6: AC1 is owed CODE, a macOS build-and-sign change with its own Opus review, not only a sitting, and no task holds it. NB7: the release.yml header should say a dispatch dry run also runs verify. None of these is started; the successor leader decides, and NB6 likely needs its own task. Reject-path and accept-path dry runs remain owed and wait on dec-14tajwo.

Reject-path proof under DEC-253 (a2), read-only, run 2026-11-01 on the Mac (this host, no billed minutes). Artifact: ward-darwin-arm64 downloaded with gh release download v0.1.0 -R opum-ai/ward-cli; sha256 458455e58974aae8d6455332d14f5747f04ee9b055f3163c29142b8e44c84904 verified against its own .sha256 (OK) and equal to the sha in docs/security-tests.md; source: the v0.1.0 Release, tag at 2aff3df1016a19ff666e0b91e0d528c01ab5e92e, built on runner linux-arm64-dccd7-runner-7mm2f, Linux aarch64, bun 1.3.14, cross-compiled (the Linux-built artifact). Command: codesign --verify --strict --verbose=2 ward-darwin-arm64. Output: "ward-darwin-arm64: invalid signature (code or signature have been modified) / In architecture: arm64". Exit code: 1. The gate rejects the Linux-built artifact, as W-1 predicted. The file was only read, never executed or installed. The accept path (AC1 macOS-signed artifact passing the same command) waits for the sitting, before the tag.

Correction, 2026-11-01: the reject-path proof recorded above ran on minim4, the Mac host, and it supersedes the earlier note saying the reject-path dry run was owed and waits on dec-14tajwo. dec-14tajwo was answered B (no billed macOS minutes), so the two-way proof runs locally on minim4 under DEC-253 (a2); the reject path is done, the accept path waits for the sitting on the AC1 macOS-signed artifact, before the tag. The hosted-job gate is WCLI-120, landed as #228 (7d8484c1c012fb957aea42469dcae8feb1b7a86c).

DEC-255 (opum-doc, relayed by team-lead 2026-11-01), publish route for 0.1.1: A with conditions. The operator sitting script builds on minim4, ad-hoc signs (W-36 A) and runs codesign --verify --strict as the gate (stop on failure), then uploads the darwin asset with gh release upload --clobber as the operator tier-3 step. (i) If a tag push triggers release.yml to publish the Linux-built asset, the sitting REPLACES it and re-downloads the published asset and runs codesign --verify --strict on the DOWNLOADED file. (ii) Every checksum or manifest the Release publishes is regenerated from the Mac-signed bytes, and the downloaded asset sha256 must match it. (iii) The runbook runner-vs-Mac byte comparison is superseded for this release; said in the runbook in the same release-path PR. Version A: 0.1.1. W-9: drop the RUNNER_HOST and uname line from the public Release notes (done in the release-path PR for this task). Measurement behind the route (minim4, macOS 27.0.1, arm64, bun 1.3.14, dev 5bf5ec8, scratch dir outside the repo, deleted): plain build sha256 bc1e5691...181f0, CDHash be2537ea48b3840df40bf215090548b9d134e093, flags adhoc,linker-signed, strict verify exit 1 (invalid signature); re-signed copy (codesign -s - --force) sha256 6bfd9434...c58d, CDHash 96d59a0fbf49e71b235c6e948a4a219dc4cbe4cb, flags adhoc, strict verify exit 0, runs (--version 0.1.0). Unmeasured: scripts/macho-cdhash.mjs on the re-signed signature. CI-route follow-up filed as WCLI-123 (required before any CI-driven release after the flip, does not gate 0.1.1). AC1 and AC5 stay open: they close in the sitting.

Verdicts and landing, opum-ai/ward-cli#232 (squash 4b39183, 2026-11-01). Round 2 at 5b607c9 REQUEST_CHANGES (fail-closed step 5 script, re-sign cdhash test; fixed at f0ed66e). Round 4 at 96cab40 APPROVE: merge onto dev passes release-workflow, verify-published-release and release-metadata 59 of 59, script mode 100755, CI green on the hosted runner. Measured on the operator Mac: the cdhash the notes script writes equals codesign -dvvv CDHash= on a Mac re-signed copy; the published v0.1.0 notes have no CR and exactly one sha256 and one cdhash line. AC1 and AC5 close in the sitting (verify-published-release.sh PASS, the superseded line on v0.1.0, the keychain re-approval steps) and are NOT ticked here. Follow-ups, one small docs/test PR after #235 and not flip gates: make step 6 idempotent and pin it in a test, give step 6 gh release edit --latest=false, make the fake codesign assert the downloaded path, and pass -R to release view and download.

AC1 and AC5 closed 2026-11-02 from the operator sitting log ward-sitting-part3-5-20261102T174256Z.log: the v0.1.1 asset downloaded from the public Release passed shasum -c and codesign --verify --strict (CHECK-OK at lines 11, 24 and 40), then installed and reported 0.1.1 (line 42). The asset was rebuilt and republished as v0.1.1 and the re-approval steps were handed to the operator and run in the part3-5b sitting logs (keychain and profile approval).

REOPENED 2026-11-02 under DEC-255 (a3), after the independent retroactive review of opum-ai/ward-cli#245 (REQUEST CHANGES). AC2 (codesign --verify --strict is a release gate in release.yml, so a failing artifact cannot be published) is UNCHECKED. The private-era v0.1.1 tag run (41368763277) published the Linux-built asset, which the verify job did not gate (it ran self-hosted and only logged the skip, DEC-253 (a2) sanctioned that); the operator then replaced it with the Mac-signed asset by hand. My earlier final summary said the release is gated on the macOS verify job; that overstated it and is cleared. The post-flip guarantee is carried by WCLI-120 AC2 (run 41503842005: verify on macos-15 rejected the Linux-built artifact, release skipped by its tag filter, gate shown structurally only) and by WCLI-123 (the macOS-built, signed, verified asset in the tag run, opum-ai/ward-cli#246). This task now depends on WCLI-120 and WCLI-123.
